question: Does aggregating across multiple Delta-t=3 anchor pairs reduce the geometric-noise mode while preserving the truth signal?
hypothesis: Cross-anchor stacking at dt=3 averages down per-pair geometric noise and improves concentration over the single-anchor result.
narrative_md: Decisive negative: aggregating across top-10 dt=3 anchor pairs gives 1.61x concentration -- slightly WORSE than the single-anchor 1.79x. The anchor-selection criterion (sum of closest-in-cloud distances) picked LARGE clouds, so each anchor contributed only ~20 surviving pairs. Per-pair geometric noise is the dominant limitation; multi-anchor stacking does not help. Uses truth-omega + truth anchors -- oracle-leak, N=1.
